description: A narashi-side pairing of a metricObservation trend with a kanae fundFlowEdge (aid-disbursement / loan / intergovernmental-transfer) in the same jurisdiction and an overlapping period. R0 skeleton per ADR-2607101800 SS3/SS8/SS6. CONSTITUTIONAL (G8, narashi-specific): this record is NON-CAUSAL BY CONSTRUCTION. `causalClaim` is a required const `false` field -- narashi MUST NOT and structurally CANNOT assert that a fund flow caused (or failed to cause) any change in an inequality metric. This is a juxtaposition of two independently-sourced facts, not an inference.

sourceCellDid.description: DID of the narashi cell that assembled this note (narashi_cross_reference)

metricObservationCids.description: >=2 narashi.metricObservation CIDs spanning the compared periods (e.g. before/after a flow window)

kanaeFundFlowEdgeCids.description: Read-only reference(s) to com.etzhayyim.kanae.fundFlowEdge records for the same jurisdiction (never written to by narashi; kanae is the sole writer)

causalClaim.description: Structural invariant (G8) -- MUST always be false. A causal-claim=true value is unrepresentable; any pipeline that would set it is a bug, not a policy choice.

observationSummary.description: Factual description of the two juxtaposed series only (e.g. 'aid-disbursement flows of $X occurred in periods P1-P2; gini moved from A to B over the same window'). MUST NOT use causal language (caused/due to/resulted in/because of).
